entries.headline: Six transports, UK surveillance sighting and Russian aircraft near Alaska reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six large US military transport aircraft airborne over North America and the North Sea. It also reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft near the United Kingdom and Russian aircraft near Alaska, without confirming their missions or a connection between the sightings.

entries.headline: Six transports, Navy surveillance aircraft and two command jets reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea. It also reported a US Navy surveillance aircraft and two nuclear command aircraft detected that day, without identifying their specific missions.

entries.headline: US transports and command aircraft; Russian aircraft near US airspace reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the continental United States. It also reported a Russian special-purpose aircraft sighted earlier near US airspace, without identifying its precise location or linking the sightings.

entries.headline: Six transports and two earlier coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one over the North Sea. It also reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard earlier that day, without identifying the messages' content or linking them to the aircraft.

entries.headline: US and North Sea transports, surveillance flight and two broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, plus a surveillance aircraft over the continental United States. It also reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard earlier that day; no specific missions or connection between the detections were confirmed.

entries.headline: Six US transports and elevated UK and North Sea activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and described military air activity over the United Kingdom and North Sea as busier than usual. It also reported two coded US Air Force radio broadcasts; the visible post did not specify the full reporting interval.

entries.headline: War Watch relays Coast Guard debris-field report off Nantucket
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed a report, credited to @charlottewilliams922, that the Coast Guard had confirmed finding a debris field off Nantucket, Massachusetts, on Saturday night. The post did not identify the debris' origin or provide details of the incident.

entries.headline: US transport and surveillance flights; continuing coded radio activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance jet airborne over the United States alongside an aircraft it described as Air Force One. It also reported continuing coded radio activity elsewhere, without identifying the messages' content or linking them to the flights.

entries.headline: North Sea transport activity and elevated civilian traffic reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel described US military transport activity over the North Sea as unusually high and civilian air traffic in the region as about six times normal levels. It also reported surveillance and command aircraft sightings, without identifying their missions in the visible post.

entries.headline: War Watch relays reports of a Ukrainian drone raid into Russia
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an OSINTtechnical report of a Ukrainian drone raid into Russia on Saturday night, crediting @reagan0965. The post attributed the estimate of several hundred active drones to local channels rather than presenting an independently confirmed count.

entries.headline: North Sea and UK transports; elevated air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple large US military transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and United Kingdom. It described regional air activity as nearly five times the normal rate, without identifying the aircraft's routes or missions.

entries.headline: Six transports and continuing coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six transport aircraft airborne over the United States and continuing coded US Air Force radio broadcasts. It described activity as above normal that day, without identifying the messages' content or establishing a connection with the flights.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert near Uruma
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US-registered military P-8 near Uruma, Japan. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: BFLO35 P-8 ground alert at Darwin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for BFLO35, described as an Australian military P-8, at Darwin, Australia. The post reported the aircraft's ground status without confirming a specific mission.

entries.headline: E-6 departure alert near Chesapeake Ranch Estates

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares YFQ-48 first-flight report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared an Aviationist report that Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48 Talon Blue had made its first autonomous flight, relating it to the Collaborative Combat Aircraft program. The post relayed the report without providing independent confirmation or a flight date.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Talon Blue autonomous-flight report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that Northrop Grumman's YFQ-48A Talon Blue had completed its first fully autonomous flight. Its commentary described the aircraft as a drone wingman for the US Air Force; the post did not provide independent confirmation or a flight date.

entries.headline: B-52 departure alert near Barstow Heights
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US Air Force B-52 near Barstow Heights, California. Its callsign field contained 00000000; the post did not confirm the aircraft's destination or specific mission.

entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for an Indian military P-8 near Kottaikadu, India. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm the flight's destination or specific mission.

entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for BP42R, described as an Indian military P-8 Poseidon, at Manavalakurichi, India. The post reported a departure without confirming its destination or mission.

entries.headline: E6 departure alert at Midwest City
